content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-001 DEEPCE Container Enumeration Script Execution) OR BIOC(CDR-001 Curl Pipe Bash Download Execute In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-001 Container Capability Mask Read From Proc1 Status) OR BIOC(CDR-001 Container Device Enumeration With Capability Inspection) OR BIOC(CDR-001 Service Account Token Access From Container) OR BIOC(CDR-001 Broad Filesystem Credential Search In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-001 LinPEAS Privilege Escalation Tool In Container) OR BIOC(CDR-001 Automated Discovery Command Burst In Container)
rules.name: Container Discovery Recon Chain — Same Container
